title: Seven heads against 32 on validation: DAgger net2 on net1 v7 (r29) at iterations 19, 39, 59, beside r27
description: Round 29 trains round 27's DAgger recipe unchanged on net1 v7 (exp-net1v6-229), which has net1 v10's data and training spec but only expliCCit's seven hand-picked heads. This run chooses round 29's iteration as round 27's was chosen (exp-dagger32-iter-val-273): every training seed of r29-means after iterations 19, 39 and 59, named r29-means-iN-sSEED, on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies, campaign seed 21, beside BBRv3; the iteration with the best mean over its training seeds on the five families wins. In the same release: round 27's (net1 v10, 32 heads) chosen policies, iteration 59 (seeds 1 and 3) and iteration 39 (seeds 1 to 3), and, as reference lines only, the fixed rule at u = 0.25 on net1 v10 (rule-v10) and on net1 v7 (rule-v7, round 29's teacher). The round 29 policies are model-dagger7-cands, copied unchanged from training run 278; round 27's are model-dagger32-cands. Validation links only; the claim is made once on the test links.
prepare: N7="$IN/v7/$(cat "$IN/v7/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N10="$IN/v10/$(cat "$IN/v10/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v7" "$N7" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v10" "$N10" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v10=$OUT/v10/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v7=$OUT/v7/rule-u0.25.onnx"); (cd "$IN/x" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/y" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); for f in "$IN"/y/ppo-r29-*.onnx "$IN"/x/ppo-r27-means-s*-i59.onnx "$IN"/x/ppo-r27-means-s*-i39.onnx; do n="$(basename "$f" .onnx)"; n="${n#ppo-}"; it="${n##*-}"; b="${n%-*}"; P+=(--policy "${b%-*}-$it-${b##*-}=$f"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 32 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s --best r29-means-i19 r29-means-i39 r29-means-i59 r27-means-i59 r27-means-i39 && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-v10
